National-team week (26 Nov – 1 Dec): an injury to Vezenkov, Maledon or Kamenjas is the main risk; the daily runs will re-check.

rumours.text: Zvezda's heaviest home EuroLeague defeat ever (84–108 v Virtus). Navarro: 'The management of the last 48 hours was not good, that's my responsibility', and apologised to the fans.
rumours.impact: Expect rotation tweaks after the break; Carter's minutes (15.7' last night) are the most exposed. Navarro (RED) is away at Fenerbahçe in R15: avoid as coach.

rumours.text: Six straight losses; Myles Cale left by mutual agreement; Tony Parker says 'maybe I will have to change some things' and will use the FIBA break to decide.
rumours.impact: Supports Bartzokas (OLY) in R15. A new signing could still land before 4 Dec, but it rarely changes the next game.

rumours.text: Bartzokas: Milutinov 'will be available, he is in good condition'. The club is searching the market for one addition after Konchar left ('the market is very limited').
rumours.impact: Milutinov trims Tyrique Jones/Dunston, not Vezenkov. A new wing would cut Ward's minutes: watch it before Thursday.

rumours.text: Vildoza expected to travel to Dubai for tonight's game; Thompson (hip) and Stevens (calf) stay in Belgrade.
rumours.impact: Vildoza's return cuts Marinkovic's minutes; Franks keeps Stevens' forward role into R15.

rumours.text: Campazzo is nearing the end of his hamstring recovery but is out tonight against Zalgiris.
rumours.impact: If he returns for R15 against Barcelona, Maledon's and Feliz's usage drops a little.

rumours.text: Zacharie Perrin has joined Baskonia; Faried, Santos and Sedekerskis still out.
rumours.impact: Kamenjas keeps the starting centre job; Perrin is a forward and mainly threatens Frisch's minutes.

review: No round has finished since the last review (R14 ends tonight), so the scorecard has nothing new. Night 1 of R14 hurt: the Zvezda stack (Carter 0, Koloko 6, Navarro −20) was yesterday's main bet and it lost by 24 at home; Diarra, whom we sold for Koloko, scored 13 in that game. Lesson: three players plus the coach on one game is a single point of failure, so A spreads R15 over Olympiacos, Virtus, Dubai and Baskonia. Research: shared with the main team (24 searches, 12 pages read); Team 2 adds no new players to verify beyond Bacon, Diarra and Diouf (unverified after 2 searches).
